scope.current_boundary: Establish rotational equilibrium only: balance clockwise and anticlockwise moments about any chosen point. Translational equilibrium (zero resultant force) and complete equilibrium conditions are deferred to lesson 9702_t04_cm02_l04. Closed vector triangles for coplanar forces are deferred to lesson 9702_t04_cm02_l05.
prior_scope_summaries_consulted: 9702_t04_cm01_l01: Represent distributed weight as acting at the centre of gravity; define and calculate moment of a force using M = F d_perp where d_perp is the perpendicular distance from pivot to line of action.

9702_t04_cm01_l02: Recognise a couple as equal, opposite, parallel forces with separate lines of action; define and calculate torque of a couple as one force multiplied by the perpendicular separation between the forces.

immediate_previous.boundary: Couples and torque. Calculate torque from one force and perpendicular separation.
can_assume: Recall moment formula M = F d_perp
Distinguish couple torque as a pure turning effect independent of pivot

immediate_next.boundary: Conditions for complete equilibrium (zero resultant force and zero resultant torque).
must_not_preteach: Equating upward and downward forces to establish complete equilibrium
Closed vector triangles for three coplanar forces

learning_design.rationale: 6 visuals map to the critical geometric representations required by Cambridge (3 authentic exam source figures, 1 vector construction of perpendicular distance, 1 schematic of the zero-moment hinge principle, and 1 multi-moment engineering signboard). 5 activities provide retrieval checkpoints for direction classification, verbatim definition assembly, equation formulation, strategic pivot selection, and tipping threshold analysis.
